Pass it on

You start with the Vangrid logo. Vangrid's opposition is closing in. Tap a teammate inside the ring to pass it on, and get it to The Paradise on the right.

Everyone keeps moving, so a late pass can miss. Aim for where they are heading. There is no timer on carrying the logo, but if the opposition reaches the carrier, it's over.
